approvers: Site manager and the glazing subcontractor; developer if it is a separate line
reason: I pay about 12 euro a m2 now with my own lads and film, and this is 19. The cap of 2,500 euro is small next to a bad block of frames. I will take a free test panel and a coffee, but I am not paying more to change what works.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it, and 2,500 euro will not cover a floor of damaged glazing. And it costs more than what I do now.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film and plastic sheet with tape, applied and removed by my own crew.
would_change_my_mind: A Maltese block I can visit where it came off clean, written confirmation from the coating maker for my glass and frames, and a price at or under 12 euro a m2 all in.
